notes: Simulation: an idle farming simulator whose loop is plant, grow, harvest, sell, and upgrade — a progressive manager, not roleplay, since the tasks are defined and repeatable rather than open-ended. plot-isolated because the map is one personal garden plot per player, fenced and never overlapping a neighbour, ringing a shared courtyard; the answer fixed that at six plots on a six-player server, which the schema cannot carry as a count so it is recorded here. Sandbox is the preset whose shape and options already describe this map: collectible-nodes is the crops the loop is built on, social-hub is the central courtyard of seed vendors, stalls and the Sheckles leaderboard, trigger-task is the dirt grid tiles and the sell NPC, and npc-population was added because the prompt asks for the vendors and shopkeepers by name. Decided without a user: the answer settles the shops as courtyard-facing stalls, so there are no enterable interiors and the build stays on P0, and plot expansion from 3x3 up to 10x10 is treated as growth within the same plot footprint rather than a purchase gate, so gate-progression was not added.
